# Hello A single static page. No build step, no dependencies. It renders one centered greeting — "Hello, and welcome." — on a dark background, and nothing else. The favicon is a white "H" on a rounded square in the same dark colour as the page. ## Files | Path | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `index.html` | The whole page — markup and inline styles | | `favicon.svg` | Favicon for modern browsers | | `favicon.ico` | Fallback favicon for browsers that ignore the SVG | ## Run it locally Open the file directly: ```sh open index.html ``` Or serve it over HTTP, which matches production more closely: ```sh python3 -m http.server 8000 # then visit http://localhost:8000 ``` ## Deploy Live at **https://suleimansh.github.io/test-project/** Deployment is GitHub Pages, driven by `.github/workflows/deploy.yml`. Every push to `main` publishes the site; it can also be run by hand from the Actions tab. One-time setup is already done on `suleimansh/test-project`: the remote exists and the Pages source is set to GitHub Actions (**Settings → Pages → Build and deployment → Source: GitHub Actions**). A fresh fork or clone needs both steps repeated before its first deploy will publish. Because this is a *project* Pages site, it is served from the `/test-project/` subpath rather than the domain root. Asset links in `index.html` are therefore relative (`favicon.ico`, not `/favicon.ico`) — a root-absolute path resolves to `suleimansh.github.io/favicon.ico` and 404s. The workflow copies only `index.html`, `favicon.ico`, and `favicon.svg` into the published artifact. The repository root is *not* deployed wholesale — anything not in that list (for example `.the-framework/`, which holds internal run logs and analysis notes) is never reachable from the public site. If you add a file that should be served, add it to the `Stage site` step or it will not ship. 0d945b1 2026-10-14T17-54-18-828Z (#5) b75a72e readme-intro-sentence (#4) c619353 readme-intro-sentence (#3) e47fb71 Wire up the live GitHub Pages deploy and fix subpath asset links 914e07f Ship real copy, add favicon, and define the deployment path c9f8697 Update homepage greeting and framework logs 671b93d Add static hello world page 0493719 [The Framework] Uncommited changes f637a04 [The Framework] install The Framework

text:
name: Deploy to GitHub Pages

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

# Let one deploy finish before the next starts; don't cancel a run mid-publish.
concurrency:
  group: pages
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      # Stage only the files that belong on the public web root. Everything else
      # in the repo (.the-framework/, notes, docs) is deliberately not copied,
      # so it can never be fetched from the deployed site.
      - name: Stage site
        run: |
          mkdir _site
          cp index.html favicon.ico favicon.svg _site/

      - uses: actions/configure-pages@v5
      - uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: _site
      - id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4
